Go from Zero to Full Stack Observability
OpsAI

Fix issues faster across any platform/language, with smart context to pinpoint the root cause in frontend or backend.

Easy Implementation

One command installation with an Otel-based agent to monitor your entire tech stack in minutes.

Unified View of Telemetry Data

Consolidate metrics, logs, traces, and events and RUM onto one unified timeline in real-time.

Data Encryption and Security

Your data is encrypted both in transit and at rest, adhering to industry standards like HIPAA, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type II.
